items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: Art Roop reported sales correctly... Art wired him to money, wired it to me.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Who are some of the record people that you most respected? I mean, the out-of-town guys that came in. That I'm most respected? Yeah, that you most respected who came in.

Well, I have to qualify almost everybody. For instance, let's say Art Roop. Okay. One of the really big ones. I have no doubt in my mind, or I could be wrong, but I have no doubt in my mind that Art Roop reported sales correctly. Mm-hmm. That Art Roop was not a person who would sell X number of records and sell... Tell you... Tell you he sold half that.
